description: Auto-generate and insert alt and aria-label attributes with Gemini API. Context-aware, and leaves decorative images empty (HTML/PHP/JSX/TSX, static paths).
command.setApiKey: Set your Gemini API key (use your own quota)
command.clearApiKey: Remove your Gemini API key (back to the shared free tier)
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: A repository can supply its own prompts file, which controls the instructions sent to the Gemini API and the text written back into your source files.
config.altGenerationMode.markdownDescrip: What the generated `alt` text is written for.
config.altGenerationMode.enum.seo: Descriptive text that names the subject using the words people would search for.
config.altGenerationMode.enum.a11y: Concise, factual text written for someone who cannot see the image.
config.decorativeKeywords.markdownDescri:
Images whose filename contains any of these words are treated as decoration: no alt text is generated and `alt=""` is left in place. Use it to skip dividers, backgrounds and logos that mean nothing when read aloud.

Matching is a case-insensitive substring match on the filename. Keep the trailing hyphen (`bg-`) so that words such as `background.jpg` are not caught as well.
config.videoDescriptionMode.markdownDesc: Whether to describe the video as a short label or as a written-out account of its content.
config.videoDescriptionMode.enum.summary: A short label that tells you what the video is without playing it, added as an `aria-label` attribute.
config.videoDescriptionMode.enum.transcr: What is said and what is shown, written out above the tag as a comment. No `aria-label` is added.
config.outputLanguage.enum.auto: Follow the VS Code display language: Japanese when the UI is Japanese, English otherwise.
config.insertionMode.markdownDescription: Whether to review the generated text before it goes into the tag.
config.insertionMode.enum.auto: Insert each result into the tag as soon as it is generated.
config.insertionMode.enum.confirm: Show each result one at a time and insert only the ones you keep.
config.contextAnalysisEnabled.markdownDe: Analyze the text around each image or video. When the surrounding text already describes it, `alt=""` is used so screen readers do not read the same thing twice.
config.customFilePath.markdownDescriptio:
Point this at a Markdown file to customize the built-in prompts. The file has to follow a specific format.

Run the command **Auto ALT Text Writer: Create a custom prompts file** to get one that already does. [How to write it, and where it can live](https://github.com/asobu-me/auto-alt-text-writer/blob/main/README.md#custom-prompts)
